answer: When the comet crosses the tundra, every beacon flashes its trail once, and the tundra ledger records the path. Each identity plants one beacon on the tundra at registration, backed by a 400,000 POA bond. Two trails converging on the same beacon post belong to one operator: both rewards burn, both bonds pass to honest peers, and the operator pays a 258,000 POA fine per fake. One fake costs 658,000 POA, and five fakes cost 3,290,000 POA before any payout clears.
